newsitem.title: UK: William Cook to send withdrawal notice.
newsitem.headline: William Cook to send withdrawal notice.

text.p: British steel firm William Cook said on Thursday that its shareholders could withdraw acceptances of the share purchase offer by engineering group Triplex Lloyd from Friday, January 3.
William Cook faces a hostile bid from Triplex Lloyd which had valued Cook at about 309 pence per share.

Triplex had said on Thursday that it was extending the bid to 1500 GMT on January 14 after it had received accpetances for about 5.83 percent of Cook's ordinary share capital by the end of December 31, 1996.
Andrew Cook, chairman of William Cook, said: "shareholders have demonstrated their overwhelming support for William Cook by continuing to reject Triplex Lloyd's ludicrously low bid".
The company's share price remained firm at 357 1/2 pence, 48 1/2 pence more than Triplex's offer price.
William Cook said it was was sending its shareholders a notice of withdrawal on Thursday.
